propositions: Gate steps in _build-and-test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml that invoke repo scripts without if-present guards hard-fail (exit 2) when the script is absent from the checked-out tree, because Gerrit Verified lane uses the workflow definition from the target branch but checks out the change's tree.

Nine unguarded steps in _build-and-test.yml and two in gerrit-verify.yaml golden-path job run scripts that were added after open changes were branched, causing spurious Verified -1 votes indistinguishable from real gate violations.
Each unguarded gate step requires an early-return guard that skips execution with a log line when the repo script is absent, matching the pattern applied to the git-floor gate in prior fix 7e90.
A structural linter must fail if any Gerrit patchset-lane workflow step running a repo script lacks the if-present guard, preventing future instances of this defect class.
